3 | ADD | Credential-bearing contexts | Shape sintetica host.invalid:5432:app:demo:84736251 in .pgpass resta leak non dichiarato: password numerica esclusa; nessun remainder proposto la copre | Rimuovere il vincolo password non numerica oppure dichiararne il limite.
4 | ADD | National IDs | passport: "AB12345" resta leak non dichiarato: label riconosciuta ma meno di sei cifre; il remainder delle label non lo copre | Dichiarare numeri identificativi fuori dalla grammatica di lunghezza/composizione, con limit: true.
5 | ADD | CRM-like names | {"client":true,"name":"Synthetic"} resta leak non dichiarato: nome personale mononimo escluso dalle 2–6 parole; il remainder della PII enumeration non copre una forma interna alla categoria | Aggiungere limite per nomi CRM fuori dalla grammatica, oppure ampliare il riconoscimento.
6 | ADD | Phones | phone: "347.123.456" resta leak non dichiarato: l’esenzione degli importi precede il matching; il remainder delle label non lo copre | Un valore esplicitamente etichettato phone non beneficia dell’esenzione importi.
7 | ADD | Tier K | ROTATION_KEY = "Ab9Cd8Ef7Gh6Ij5Kl4M" resta leak non dichiarato: 19 caratteri; il punto 7 testa 20–31 ma non dichiara la banda inferiore | Dichiarare valori Tier K sotto soglia, con una riga a 19 caratteri.
8 | ADD | Literals, references and placeholders | PASSWORD = "changeme", quando è la password effettiva, resta leak non dichiarato; nessun remainder proposto copre l’esenzione placeholder | Dichiarare credenziali effettive identiche ai placeholder come limite, con riga dedicata.
9 | OBJECT | 2 | PASSWORD_FILE_TOKEN = "Ab9Cd8Ef7Gh6Ij5Kl4Mn3" rischia l’esenzione per FILE benché TOKEN successivo sia sensibile | Una property word esenta solo se successiva all’ultimo stem sensibile; fissare precedenza e righe.
10 | ADD | 3 | store.put("PASSWORD","p4ss-synthetic") rimane fuori dai carrier; sarebbe dichiarato solo da un remainder universale, non dalla sola frase sui passaggi senza nome | Il complemento comprende tutti i carrier non enumerati, inclusi setter con nome esplicito.
11 | OBJECT | 6 | export PASSWORD=$PASSWORD e PASSWORD=$(fetch_secret) cmd sono innocenze che “ogni valore non quotato” farebbe skip | Nei carrier shell restano innocenti riferimenti, interpolazioni e command substitution integrali.
12 | OBJECT | 6 | password: Optional[str] è un’annotazione innocente che la nuova grammatica scalare classificherebbe come literal | Conservare wrapper di annotazione, generics, union e riferimenti qualificati riconosciuti.

14 | ADD | 2 | BYPASS_MODE = "yes" rischia skip per il suffisso PASS di un segmento; l’eccezione attuale riguarda il nome intero | Applicare le eccezioni lessicali a ciascun segmento prima del suffix matching.
15 | AGREE | 4–5 | Le aggiunte chiudono le otto forme nominate, ma le soglie devono avere boundary rows | Aggiungere coppie 5/6 cifre Tier P, carrier generici, label normalizzate e redis-cli -a.
16 | OBJECT | 7 | rule opzionale verifica presenza del testo, non copertura obbligatoria né comportamento | Rendere rule obbligatorio per righe normative e associare ogni regola a un test comportamentale o mutation test.

1 | AGREE | 3 | Explicit remainder sentence added to closed list definitions with `limit: true` row | Addresses defect of lists without declared limits (point 1 of method change).
2 | AGREE | 3 | Tier P/S/K rule updated to match ANY name segment as suffix unless LATER segment is property word, closing DB_PASSWORD_FILE as remainder | Fixes PII leak via `DB_PASSWORD_FILE` and handles `PGPASSWORD` stem matching without skipping legitimate stems.
3 | ADD | 3 | Assignment carrier definition expanded to include `<expr>['NAME']`, `.setdefault()`, positional args (e.g., `connect(..., "app", "<pw>")`) with explicit remainder clause | Closes leak of positionally passed credentials previously missed by os.environ-only rule.
4 | OBJECT | 3 | Proposed wording: "Tier K >= 8 chars all-digits is guilt unless explicitly listed in closed ID tables" | Shorter digit literals (<8) are currently innocent but `C01X00T47` (8 digits+letters) leaks; spec requires closing remainder for unlisted tool outputs or short IDs.
5 | ADD | 3 | Phone label list expanded to `telepon`, `telephone`, `cell`; normalized matching applied with explicit "unlisted label" remainder | Declares `telepon: "347..."` as leak and adds `ufficio:`/`ssn:` as declared limits (remainder).
6 | ADD | 3 | Annotation rule refined: identifiers starting with Cap+AlphaNum where digit runs followed by Cap are types; others are literals; identifier-shaped passwords are `lim_03` remainder | Resolves contradiction of `Ed25519PrivateKey` being quoted as type vs literal guilt; captures `Sup3rSecret` without skipping innocence.
7 | AGREE | 4 | CLI flag list updated to include `redis-cli -a`, `--pass`, `--authkey`; remainder added for unlisted tools like `ldapsearch -w` | Ensures `redis-cli -a lit` and similar flags are caught while allowing other tools via remainder.
8 | AGREE | 6 | Card numbers (PAN) and IBANs listed as OUT of scope with "owner decision pending" clause retained | Maintains declared limits for financial data to avoid over-blocking per policy.
9 | ADD | 3 | Environment carrier rule extended: `env["VAR"] = lit`, `os.environ[...]` treated as named assignment regardless of `lit` vs var | Declares `env["PGPASSWORD"] = lit` and `payload["secret_token"] = lit` as leaks without skipping innocuous env vars.
10 | ADD | 3 | Redis-cli context clarified: `-a <lit>` is credential; unlisted tools remain valid via remainder clause | Prevents false innocence for `redis-cli -a` while keeping `ldapsearch` safe as declared limit.
11 | OBJECT | 4 | Proposed wording: "Short all-digit literals (1–7 digits) are declared limits (innocent)" | Addresses that `password: 84736251` (8 digits) leaks but short PINs (<8) should not be flagged unless in specific context; current rule says >=6 is guilt, missing the nuance for unlisted tools or IDs.
12 | AGREE | 5 | Label list expansion with normalisation and explicit remainder for `ufficio`, `ssn` covers `document_number`, `no_dokumen`, `nomor` etc | Covers all ID label variants including `national_id` and handles cases like `telepon` without skipping valid non-PII fields.
13 | ADD | 6 | Tier P/S/K stem matching clarified: suffix match only if name ends in stem or contains stem not preceded by property word; `DB_PASSWORD_FILE` remains remainder | Ensures `DB_PASSWORD_2 = lit` (stem ends name) is caught but `file_password` or similar non-credential contexts are declared limits.
14 | ADD | 3 | Positional credential passing (`connect(host, "app", "<pw>")`) added to carriers with explicit remainder clause | Closes leak of positionally passed secrets which were previously missed by `os.environ`-only rule.
15 | AGREE | 7 | Schema test failure condition explicitly stated: dropping a `rule:` phrase makes the row red (must match spec) | Enforces discipline on corpus rows to prevent silent omissions like missing rules in previous failures.
16 | ADD | 6 | PII enumeration closed with explicit remainder for unlisted labels (`fficio`, `ssn`) and tool flags | Addresses the self-contradiction where `private_key` was cited as annotation but treated as literal; now consistent via rule 6.
17 | AGREE | 3 | Carrier definition includes all subscript forms: `<expr>["NAME"]`, `.setdefault()`, positional args, env vars | Ensures `env["PGPASSWORD"] = lit` and similar are detected without false positives on non-credential keys.
18 | ADD | 4 | All-digit Tier P literal guilt threshold lowered to >=6 digits; shorter all-digits (1–5) declared innocent unless in specific ID context | Aligns with `password: 84736251` (8 digits, guilty) but allows short PINs as declared limits if unlisted.
19 | ADD | 5 | Phone label list includes `telepon`, `telephone`, `cell` and handles normalization; remainder for unlisted labels like `ufficio:` | Covers all ID/phone label variants including regional terms without skipping valid non-PII fields.
20 | AGREE | 6 | Annotation rule refinement: CamelCase identifiers with digits followed by caps are types; mixed-class literals guilt | Fixes the contradiction where `Ed25519PrivateKey` was incorrectly flagged as literal when it should be a type annotation remainder.
